# Mathis Humbert

> Mathis Humbert is a self-taught creative developer, front-end developer and design engineer. He works as a creative developer at Locomotive (https://locomotive.ca/) and runs his own freelance practice, building award-winning websites for agencies, startups and companies worldwide.

## Expertise

- Creative development and creative front-end development
- Design engineering: turning design into pixel-perfect, production-ready interfaces
- Interactive animation and motion (GSAP, custom scroll and page transitions)
- 3D and WebGL experiences (Three.js, GLSL shaders)
- Web performance and accessibility
